title: Learning with curiosity
description: A short introduction to asking better questions and making new ideas stick.

lessons.title: Start with a good question
lessons.description: Turn curiosity into a clear learning goal.
lessons.content:
# Begin with curiosity

Learning starts with a question you care about. A useful question is specific enough to explore, but open enough to lead somewhere new.

## Try it yourself

1. Choose a topic you want to understand.
2. Write down what you already know.
3. Ask one question that would move your understanding forward.

> You do not need to know everything before you begin. You need a place to start.

## A small example

Instead of **“Learn about plants”**, try **“How do plants turn sunlight into energy?”**

Keep your question somewhere visible. You will return to it as you learn.

questions.explanation: Begin with a question you care about.

lessons.title: Make an idea your own
lessons.description: Use explanation and reflection to deepen understanding.
lessons.content:
# Explain it simply

After reading something new, pause and explain it in your own words. Imagine you are helping a curious friend.

## A short reflection

- What is the main idea?
- Which example makes it clearer?
- What would you like to understand next?

**Try this:** write three sentences without looking back at your notes. Then reread the lesson and notice what you missed.

## Keep exploring

Understanding grows through practice. Return to a useful idea, connect it to something familiar, and ask your next question.
